function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT pl.vendor_id, v.vendor_name, SUM(pl.amount_cad - (pl.qty * pl.contract_unit_price * pl.fx_rate)) AS excess_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl
JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.vendor v ON pl.vendor_id = v.vendor_id
WHERE pl.period = '2026-09'
GROUP BY pl.vendor_id, v.vendor_name
HAVING excess_cad > 0
ORDER BY excess_cad DESC","purpose":"Aggregate excess CAD by vendor for September 2026 where unit price > contract price"}
